description: This file defines a command class for exporting saved queries and related database information in the Apache Superset project. It includes methods for generating filenames, file contents, and exporting query and database data as YAML.

classes.name: ExportSavedQueriesCommand
classes.description: A command class for exporting saved queries and associated database information in YAML format.

methods.name: _file_name
methods.description: Generates a filename for a saved query based on database, schema, and label.

methods.name: _file_content
methods.description: Creates YAML content for a saved query, including version and database UUID.

methods.name: _export
methods.description: Yields filename and content for a saved query and optionally its related database as YAML.
